primary_question: Which integrity layer detects each declared certificate mutation threat?

expected_boundary.graph_digests: detect outer-resealed mutations when graph-local digests are stale
expected_boundary.unsigned_full_rehash: cannot authenticate semantic content against an attacker who can recompute every unkeyed hash
expected_boundary.ed25519_signature: detects every post-signing certificate byte change relative to a trusted public key

inference_boundary: Mechanism and attack-family coverage only; repeated generated attacks do not estimate real-world attack prevalence.
